# MultimoduleSensor:pushFrame

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.6.0</span></div>

Push a Multimodule frame.

```lua
local result = sensor:pushFrame(data)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | table | yes |  |

## Returns

result (boolean)

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
sensor:pushFrame({ 0x00, 0xEA })
```
